activity.notes: Otto I was crowned Roman emperor in Rome on 2 February 962 and remained emperor until his death on 7 May 973. ATLAS uses the established historical catalog identity Holy Roman Empire for the imperial phase requested by the user; this does not back-project the later formal wording of the imperial title into Otto's own titulature.

sources.title: Otto I — Encyclopaedia Britannica, 11th edition
sources.citation_text: The Britannica biography records Otto's imperial coronation at Rome on 2 February 962 and his death at Memleben on 7 May 973.
